$comment: How a member appears to the others (chapter 21): one profile per user. Assets point at it through the `author` reference, so a list can show who wrote each one without a request per card. The profile belongs to its owner (_meta.owner), which is how the reference finds it.

name.description: The name shown next to what the member wrote.

avatar.description: An initial, an emoji or a short text shown beside the name.
